record.question: The most common factor for environmental pollution due to the use of pharmaceuticals is mainly due to:
options: Widespread use of vaccines for universal immunization schedule
Excessive consumption of pharmaceuticals in Govt hospitals
record.explanation: Answer B: Improper disposal of expired medicines. Improper disposal of unused and expired pharmaceuticals can release active compounds into wastewater and the environment. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241516198. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
